beats.narration_text: Olá — Vedanshu here. Chapter seven traced the pipeline and skipped a step: augment. Retrieval hands back chunks, and something has to turn them into one block of text for the model. That sounds like joining strings together. It is not. Chapter eight is about what the assembly changes.

beats.narration_text: Here is the whole idea in one breath. Assembling a RAG prompt is a set of deliberate choices — and the layout is what the model actually reads. Labels, placement, and one instruction about staying grounded. Each of them changes the answer you get back.

beats.role_note: EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY LAW — the correction IS the chapter's own misconception: §1 frames the augment stage as 'concatenate a few strings together' before showing it is not. Single-token trigger: the component matches whitespace-delimited tokens, so a phrase trigger silently fails.

beats.act: the anatomy — same content, two layouts
beats.narration_text: Same content, two layouts. On the left the instruction, both retrieved chunks and the question run together as one paragraph, with no indication of where anything begins. The model has to guess which text is which. On the right nothing was added. It was only labelled and separated. Instructions here. Context here, each chunk tagged with the document it came from. Question here.

beats.act: grounding instructions reduce the risk without removing it
beats.narration_text: A prompt can also just ask: answer only from what I gave you, and say so if it isn't there. That is a documented technique and it does help. But it is a natural-language request competing with everything the model learned in training. An answer can open correctly grounded and then keep going, unsupported — and the accurate opening is exactly what makes the rest look reliable.

props.headline: Grounded, Then Drifting.
props.sparkLine: The true opening is the camouflage.
props.instruction: Answer only using the provided context. If the context does not contain the answer, say so.

sentences.text: Two weeks' written notice is required for resignation.
Most employers also expect a handover document and an exit interview within that period.

props.warning: An accurate first sentence lends the whole answer an appearance of reliability it has not earned.
props.caption: Asking a model to use only the provided documents is a documented technique, not a hard guarantee — the chapter is explicit that grounding instructions reduce the risk rather than eliminate it.
props.citation: Anthropic, Claude Platform Docs; Ch. 8 §“Grounding instructions”

beats.narration_text: Here is the well-assembled version, annotated. An instruction block that says answer only from the context, and admit it if the answer isn't there. Each chunk in its own labelled section, tagged with the document it came from. The question marked as the question. Now the model can see that the resignation policy is the relevant chunk, ignore HR contacts, and cite the right file.

beats.narration_text: So: the augment stage is an assembly, not a concatenation. Three parts — instructions, context, question — labelled so the model can tell them apart, and each chunk tagged so a claim can be traced back to a document. And a grounding instruction reduces the risk of an unsupported answer without removing it. Which is the honest version: good assembly improves the odds. It does not buy a guarantee.

artifactLines: Three parts, each labelled: instructions, context, question.
Every chunk tagged with its source, so a claim can be attributed.
“Use only the provided context” reduces drift. It does not stop it.
Good assembly improves the odds. It does not buy a guarantee.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this: take the prompt my RAG system actually sends and print it exactly as the model receives it. Then mark where the instructions end, where each retrieved chunk begins and which document it came from, and where the question starts. If any boundary is only a blank line, say so. Run that against your own pipeline. Most people have never read the assembled string — only the code that builds it. The blank lines are where this chapter bites.
